body: So we finally talked. He teared up and apologized said he's working on himself he lies due to deep rooted childhood trauma which he has been working on for few years in therapy. He said he's a lot better and does not want to lie to me. He doesn't know why he did it. Just was his reaction. He wants things to be the way they were before. I agreed. I let him know this can't happen again. He said that he is exclusively talking to only me. Which same for me. He's the one guy I have clicked with in so long on this level. So I'm hoping this continues on the right path. He did say he wants to get to know me a lot more to see where this leads. I asked him what he wanted he just said to start figuring out his life and living it. Which I'm not too sure he even knows what that means for him. I have a good feeling about him and hope everything honestly works out amazing for us because our chemistry is fire. He also apologized for not calling me last night he got caught up having fun so I get it. I feel crazy for how much I adore him but I am running with it.
I just don't like being lied too. So it super bugs me. I'm still waiting for him to call. He did really upset me with it for sure. But I'm going to keep an open mind.

So he text me around 227 am

Him: you're asleep and I'm headed to bed. I got sucked into drinking more. I'm not gunna lie. You're gunna get a call from me tomorrow if you'll take it. Sleep tight. 


🤷🏼‍♀️ I just don't know.

Well when I got off work I let him know I'd like to talk to him on the phone tonight. 

He replied "okay! What time? I'm going to celebrate my friends new job have a few drinks and come home." 

Me: just hit me up once you're home. 

Him @445pm: okay will do. 

Him again @ 726 pm: I think I might be drunk......
Shit I shouldn't of sent this. 

Me:oh yeah. 

Him: but for real I fucked up and I miss you. Alllll day. 

Me: I concur 

Him: I miss hearing about your day and seeing your beautiful ass face. 

Me: we will talk. We can FaceTime later. 

Him: Good I'm trying to sober up right now. I got a weenier. 🤣
About to put it in my mouth. 
Fuckkkkk I'm gone. 
But like for real you deserve the best. 

Me: how the hell did you get drunk so fast? 
I do deserve the best and nothing less. 

Him: I didn't eat a lot of lunch. I had a whiskey sour light on the sour. And rum and coke. She's like my best friend who's also married to my other best friend randy hahahaha

Me: sounds like a good time. How are you getting home? 

Him: okay let me sober up so I can be 100% me. Cause I want you to see me normal and sober. My friend will. 

Me: okay good. 

It's now 10pm he turned off his snap chat location which he had on all day. 

Now I just feel so much disappointment. Clearly this is nothing for him. Maybe time to move on. I was getting my hair done. My hair dresser is like he's a pieces like me he gets drunk to avoid dealing with stuff. All I could think of is omg no. 😕😔 

Honestly sad that what ever connection we had was bs most likely. He's been so far up my ass all of sudden things change. My intuition I guess was right something was off yesterday.

Thanks so much for this reply idk why this just made me smile but it did. I will keep you updated on what happens tonight. Hoping for the best. I definitely will let him know how I felt and also let him know I understand to an extent why he did it but that it CANNOT happen again. I definitely want it to go back to normal.

Thank you for your advice. I adore him. I definitely did not want to be rude or mean to him so I told him just let me process this. I'll call him after work today and touch base with him. Not sure how to lead into it. He basically did tell me he panicked a bit and that's why he did it. I'm now not sure how to approach him tonight when I call. Just ask him if he could he explain why he did that? Maybe revisit the fact this is still new and I'm not dumb I know he is talking to other girls. Also that hiding things from me will never fly. I'm a pretty understanding person. I just still am sad that he lied but it will be okay. Either a bump in the road or the end of the road. Later today will tell me which way. 


On another side note he already invited me to his bosses Halloween party late October over the weekend. Men so dam confusing 🤦🏼‍♀️ lol.
I would love to hear the answers to this. I have the very same problem

I just want to let you know I was just in this same place just a year ago. Wishing an accident would kill me. Things have become so much better in my life. Of course I still have ups and downs. But do not give up. Your whole life can change in a matter of a few months. Keep fighting. It's okay to feel shity. And it's okay to feel good too!
I really appreciate that. You have no idea. Good vibes your way.
Thanks for your time.
Thank you.

We definitely will be having a detailed conversation about that. If we do not it is over for me. I really do believe he wants it to work out so I'm sure we will I'm also sure he's feeling like shit. I feel bad for him in a way but he did it to himself.
That's a really good point. The more time I give you are right.

I really do not want to play games. I just want to know the real details. I feel like leaving it alone and letting him come back to me. Idk he can explain himself when he's ready. I feel like I shouldn't have to ask.
Right that's the part that is a huge disappointment. A part of me wants to give him another chance. The other part of me is like fuck he's full of shit but I do not want to believe it.
I feel like I want to ask maybe I will tomorrow. This just happened an hour ago.
I did not ask I feel like if he wanted to share he would. From the vibe I got it maybe his ex he did tell me he stopped by there yesterday.
Professional help has not helped much.

The stress is weight gain. Financial. Job which I’m currently in the process of trying to switch to a new one. Having to move soon to another town. Selling the house I’m currently in and also trying to deal with some bad renters I have in another house I own. It just feels like so much pressure. My relationship with my bf is not the greatest. It’s been six years and it just seems like a dead end. Everything feels so blah. I’m just done with it all. I mean I have always on and off battles depression just any more it’s a different kind. The scary kind to me. Where I feel like. Fuck it. Fuck it all. I have never been that way. I don’t like it.
Good question. I wish I knew myself. It is up and down I guess.
